new_claim.statement: For an exact-rank-three target A=RMR^T with |eig M|>=1, a heavy original physical row u0=sqrt(h)r, h>1/2, and 0<|A00|<1/32, if the residual original coordinates split exactly into rows parallel to r and rows perpendicular to r, then ||p_(X^TAX)||_infinity<147.530. The proof retains the nonzero Rayleigh term and uses genuine disjoint-source independence.

new_corollary.statement: After splicing the latest account02/B18 heavy-pivot, exact-null, and double-heavy theorems, every exact-rank-three target whose heavy row admits this exact source-separated residual longitudinal/transverse decomposition satisfies ||p_Q||_infinity<363.

designated_partner_result_applied.application: The partner pays |A00|>=1/32 by <256sqrt(2), exact-null heavy anchors by <363, and any punctured state with a transverse-heavy residual row by <363. The only remaining source-separated punctured collar is paid here by <147.530.

analytic_dependencies.statement: For a cap-one scalar independent of a dependent pair with joint cap M, ||p_Q||_infinity<=31 M^(2/3)|beta^2 gamma det B|^(-1/6), uniformly in the scalar pivot.
For a 2D orthogonal projection of cap-one product input and invertible symmetric S, sup_t E|Z^T S Z-t|^(-1/2)<=16sqrt(30)|det S|^(-1/4) in the zero-affine case.

primary_sources_checked: Galyna Livshyts, Grigoris Paouris, Peter Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, arXiv:1507.07949 / Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), Theorem 1.1
Tomas Juškevičius, Jungbin Lee, Small ball probabilities, maximum density and rearrangements

source_valid_transfer.claim: On disjoint ORIGINAL-coordinate source banks, the longitudinal norm-one aggregate has density <=sqrt(2), the transverse orthogonal 2D projection has joint density <=2, and these two objects are genuinely independent because the source-coordinate sets are disjoint.
source_valid_transfer.warning: This does not extend to overlapping longitudinal/transverse projections; a joint density cap does not create independence.

continuity: not claimed for the new punctured nonzero-pivot theorem; retained only on already-completed partner branches that explicitly prove an L1 characteristic-function envelope
unresolved_implication: QFORM-NEARNULL-OVERLAPPING-SOURCE-COLLAR-v1: pay the same near-null heavy-anchor geometry when residual rows have simultaneous longitudinal and transverse components, without promoting a joint cap to independence or deleting the small Rayleigh term.
next_step: Use a product-preserving grouped-projection/crossing interface to extract the independent-scalar/dependent-pair packet from the overlapping-source collar, or prove a direct selector-preserving analogue that allows the longitudinal aggregate to share source coordinates with the transverse pair.
